verses.text: The leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem. The rest of the people threw lots to choose one out of every ten families to live in Jerusalem, the holy city. The other nine stayed in their own towns.
The people praised all the men who offered to live in Jerusalem.

These are the leaders of the province who lived in Jerusalem. Other Israelites, priests, Levites, temple servants, and descendants of Solomon's servants lived on their own property in the towns of Judah.
Some of the people of Judah and Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. From Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, son of Zechariah, son of Amariah, son of Shephatiah, son of Mahalalel, a descendant of Perez;
and Maaseiah son of Baruch, son of Col-Hozeh, son of Hazaiah, son of Adaiah, son of Joiarib, son of Zechariah, a descendant of Shelah.
The descendants of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight brave men.
From Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Joed, son of Pedaiah, son of Kolaiah, son of Maaseiah, son of Ithiel, son of Jeshaiah;
and after him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight men in all.
Joel son of Zichri was their leader, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second in charge of the city.
From the priests: Jedaiah son of Joiarib; Jachin;
Seraiah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, the official in charge of God's temple;
and their fellow priests who did the work in the temple, eight hundred twenty-two men. Also Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pelaliah, son of Amzi, son of Zechariah, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah;
and his relatives, who were family leaders, two hundred forty-two men. Also Amashsai son of Azarel, son of Ahzai, son of Meshillemoth, son of Immer;
and his relatives, who were brave warriors, one hundred twenty-eight men. Their leader was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.
From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, son of Bunni;
Shabbethai and Jozabad, two of the leaders of the Levites, who were in charge of the outside work of God's temple;
Mattaniah son of Mica, son of Zabdi, son of Asaph, who led the thanksgiving and prayer; Bakbukiah, who was second among his relatives; and Abda son of Shammua, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun.
There were two hundred eighty-four Levites in all in the holy city.
The gatekeepers were Akkub, Talmon, and their relatives, who guarded the gates. There were one hundred seventy-two of them.
The rest of the Israelites, priests, and Levites lived in all the towns of Judah, each on their own family land.
The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel. Ziha and Gishpa were in charge of them.
The leader of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani, son of Hashabiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Mica. He was one of Asaph's descendants, the singers in charge of the service in God's temple.
The king had given orders about the singers, and they received a fixed amount every day.
Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, a descendant of Zerah son of Judah, was the king's helper in everything that had to do with the people.
As for the villages and their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,
in Jeshua, Moladah, Beth Pelet,
Hazar Shual, and in Beersheba and its towns,
in Ziklag, and in Meconah and its towns,
in En Rimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth,
Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, in Lachish and its fields, and in Azekah and its towns. So they settled all the way from Beersheba to the Valley of Hinnom.
The people of Benjamin lived from Geba onward, in Michmash, Aija, and Bethel and its towns,
in Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
Lod, and Ono, in the Valley of Craftsmen.
Some groups of Levites from Judah settled in the land of Benjamin.
